proposed_fields.description: Sourced count of active customers/practices (integer). Use when a press release or investor post gives a stated customer/practice count (e.g., '700+ practices').
proposed_fields.hypothesis: ABM sellers need a straightforward, searchable numeric metric for customer footprint (e.g., number of practices/customers) to prioritize outreach and expansion motions; having a discrete customer_count field enables segmentation by traction and quick qualification against ICP thresholds.
proposed_fields.example_evidence_span: Lassie already works with more than 700 practices across 49 states, generates more than $10 million in annualized revenue, and provides practices with 250,000 hours of labor a year.

proposed_fields.description: Short text describing geographic coverage (countries or number of states/regions) as reported by the company or investors.
proposed_fields.hypothesis: Knowing geographic coverage (for example '49 states' or 'US only') helps sales prioritize accounts by territory fit and compliance/regulatory relevance; a dedicated field avoids overloading free-text company descriptions.
proposed_fields.example_evidence_span: Lassie already works with more than 700 practices across 49 states, generates more than $10 million in annualized revenue, and provides practices with 250,000 hours of labor a year.

proposed_fields.description: A numeric estimate of hours saved per year across customers as reported by the company or investor materials (e.g., '250,000 hours of labor a year').
proposed_fields.hypothesis: Quantified impact metrics like aggregate hours saved are powerful GTM hooks and ICP filters; capturing them in a structured field enables value-based segmentation and tailored outreach to accounts where operational ROI is demonstrable.
proposed_fields.example_evidence_span: Lassie already works with more than 700 practices across 49 states, generates more than $10 million in annualized revenue, and provides practices with 250,000 hours of labor a year.
